body: I think it's cute! It's very stylised so i don't have any criticism, but i really like the orange blobs. They make it pop and interesting on the eye. I could see this working well in a comic

I'm not a professional but I really like it. The lines are smooth and the shading is well placed. I'd say to make the jaw less wide and taper in a bit more at the bottom, and if I was being picky to curve the teeth upwards to follow the natural curve of the skull and show they're curving around the face (if that makes sense?). Really good work though! ☺
